cards.text: After the flood, Noah's family has grown into whole nations. And right now, the whole world has one language and a common form of speech. No translator, no subtitles, no "sorry, say that again?" Friend, that's a WONDERFUL world.
People are on the move, journeying eastward. They find a wide, flat plain and decide this is the spot. They settle down right there.

cards.question: Journeying eastward, the people find a plain and settle there. What land is it in?

cards.text: They say to one another, "Come, let us make bricks and bake them thoroughly." BAKE! Finally, my word! I left a batch in the oven too long once, and baker, those cookies could've held up a wall.

cards.question: To build with those baked bricks, the people use brick instead of ___ and tar instead of ___.

cards.text: Then the plan gets BIGGER. They want to build themselves a city with "a tower that reaches to the heavens" and a whole lot of brick.

cards.question: The people want to build a city with a tower that reaches to the heavens. What do they say it's for?

answers.text: To make a name for themselves
To guard the plain from enemies

cards.question: The people also say the tower will keep them from being scattered over the face of all the earth.

cards.text: Brick by brick, up it goes. Then the LORD comes down to see the city and the tower. Friend, they built that thing to reach the heavens... and the LORD still came DOWN to see it.
Then the LORD speaks about them. One people. One language. All working on the same thing.

cards.question: The LORD says these people have begun this as one people speaking the same language. What does He say that means?

answers.text: Nothing they devise will be beyond them
They will soon run out of land to build on
They will soon turn against each other

cards.question: Then the LORD says, Come, let Us go down. His plan for the builders is to confuse their ___.
When the LORD confuses the builders' language, they won't understand one another's speech.

cards.text: So the LORD scattered them from there over the face of all the earth. The one thing that tower was supposed to stop? Yeah. That one.

cards.question: Once the LORD scatters the people, they keep right on building the city.
The place where the people built their city and tower gets called Babel. Why that name?

answers.text: The LORD confused the language there
The people named it after a king
The name means city of brick

cards.text: There the LORD confused the language of the whole world. You ever call customer service and the recording starts up in a language you've never heard? "Press one for..." WHAT is one for?!
And from that place, the LORD scattered them over the face of all the earth. Big plans, baker. Bigger God.
